purpose: Game-safe universal family vocabulary coverage. Tier 1 and Tier 2 reuse their richer target profiles; Tier 3 contributes candidate forms for recognition and matching games without claiming a full grammar or culture lesson path.

safety.tier1_tier2: Use structured target-profile features and only emit a single-answer production prompt when the profile proves the answer is unique.
safety.tier3: Recognition and multi-match only until language-specific review. Slash-separated alternatives may encode age, speaker gender, maternal/paternal side, register, relationship path, or another lexical subdivision and must not be flattened into one fake equivalent.
safety.all: A structurally complete game row remains Machine created until language-specific review promotes it.
